checks.name: Only allowed entities: foundry, assembling machine 3, chemical plant, electric furnace, fast, bulk and long-handed inserters, fast and express belts, undergrounds and splitters, pipes, substations, panels, provider chests and the governors' combinators
Unique entity numbers
Blueprint version is 2.1.25
No modules, no quality above normal, no tiles, no custom arm reach
No two entities share a tile
Published footprint is the envelope of all entities, top-left tile (0, 0)
Entity counts match the manifest
Machines are exactly the manifest list
Every foundry, assembling machine and chemical plant has a fixed recipe in the blueprint; the electric furnaces smelt what they are given (stone)
No machine has a circuit connection or a recipe set by circuit
Every recipe has at least the whole machines its arithmetic needs at the target
Machine counts match the manifest
Every arm has its hand size pinned (fast 1, bulk 2, long-handed 1)
Every arm takes from a machine or a belt and gives to a machine, a belt or a chest
Fluid rules: every pipe network carries exactly one fluid, every pipe-to-ground has its partner, every machine port its recipe uses meets a pipe, and no port meets a pipe of another fluid
Fluid ports are plain pipes on networks of their own fluid
Every machine, arm and combinator is inside a substation supply area
Substations only, wired into one copper network within wire reach
One power entry: the marked substation, labelled, on the manifest list
Every port entity stands on the footprint edge it names; entrance belts run inward, the stone exit outward
Every port has a visible panel beside it with its item icon and per-minute figure
The panel figures are the recipe totals at the target, rounded up
Each pack has its own passive provider chest limited to five stacks (1,000 packs), filled by one filtered fast arm run by its own governor
Circuit wires join only the governors: combinators and the two chest arms
Blueprint label, description and four icons are set
